# Alignment Questionnaire

Answer by marking one option for each question. If you do not answer a question, Codex will use the recommended default.

## Questions

1. What outcome should this feature optimize for?
   - [x] A. Ship a small reliable MVP first. Recommended default.
   - [ ] B. Explore a broader design before implementation.
   - [ ] C. Prioritize speed over polish for an internal prototype.
   - [ ] D. Other: {describe your preference}

2. Who is the first user of this feature?
   - [x] A. The repository owner or primary developer. Recommended default.
   - [ ] B. A small internal team.
   - [ ] C. External users or customers.
   - [ ] D. Other: {describe the user}

3. How strict should verification be?
   - [x] A. Run focused tests for changed code and provide smoke-test steps. Recommended default.
   - [ ] B. Require unit, BDD, and E2E coverage for every applicable change.
   - [ ] C. Use manual smoke testing only.
   - [ ] D. Other: {describe verification needs}

4. What should happen if requirements are still unclear after alignment?
   - [x] A. Append follow-up questions and wait for answers. Recommended default.
   - [ ] B. Continue with documented assumptions.
   - [ ] C. Stop and ask in chat before editing files.
   - [ ] D. Other: {describe escalation preference}
